performance.independentUnit: process; two measured observations per schedule inside each process
performance.timingScope: synthetic native owner loop, not publisher Prepared, gossip or live deadlines

limits: Six independent matched process pairs across ABBA/BAAB/ABBA; two measured observations per schedule in each process are not independent replicates.
Only fixed_work has equal intermediate sealing work. deployed_owner uses the existing 16-attempt/20ms/250ms scheduling and may seal different prefixes.
Runtime/Host/Intake use production-default SafeAllocator options. Fixture, Io and assertion allocations still use the test allocator.
Synthetic 65536-slot parent, 8192 writes, 65 transactions, two branches, 300M gas ceiling and 60s session allowance.
Runtime reserves worker512MiB/session128MiB/result16MiB/retained128MiB; these fixture reserves are not a qualification of deployed resource headroom.
Host load and CPU pressure are recorded; CPU affinity/governor and other user workloads were not controlled. Leaf cgroup counters did not expose a throttling count.
Allocation injection covers backing allocator/arena-refill failure points; not every logical scratch allocation site or reuse after every mid-read OOM.
Reconstructed receipt bytes supplement complete payload/header/root equality. Prior strong-poison allocator cohort separately covers retained ownership.
No live network, Prepared, gossip, proposer-delivery, deadline or bid-outcome claim. No live database was opened.
